formal_definition: Typed finite profile combining a cone relation, log-polar chart, modular time, topology, grammar and two 64-bit key layouts.
T is slant length; t is linear time; X is a modular tick; phi is a hoop angle; delta_rho and epsilon_guard are distinct.
Represent phi as a periodic angle in R/(2pi Z); do not identify it with the golden ratio Phi.
Separate log-radius increment, time increment, finite-difference step, jitter amplitude and guard margin.
Every claim is labeled source-derived, corrected, bounded or rejected and carries a profile scope.

mechanism: Cone from slant length and half-angle
formal_definition: Given T>0 and alpha in (0,pi/2), derive height h=T cos alpha and base radius R=T sin alpha.
Reduce to signed distance from the meridian point to the filled triangle (-R,h),(R,h),(0,0).
Classify a finite-cone residual as interior, guard-zero or exterior with a declared epsilon.
Use ||x-c||-R as an exact local spherical relation.
Treat the two-sphered eye motif as two local spherical supports with union/intersection and overlap tags.
C(u)=C0+s(u) with fixed orientation and a declared finite interval.
Uniform samples plus the 1-Lipschitz translation law bound the true sweep infimum in [m-Lh/2,m].
Project a proposed velocity with P=I-n n^T so its first-order field derivative vanishes on a regular zero set.
rho=ln(r/r0), theta=atan2(y,x) with an explicit core radius.
The logarithmic chart does not remove the r=0 singularity; a core flag and radius are mandatory.
In the plane ds^2=r^2(d rho^2+d theta^2), so the metric factor is r^2=e^(2 rho) r0^2.
A log step delta_rho gives delta_r=r(exp(delta_rho)-1), approximately r delta_rho only to first order.
J=r[[cos theta,-sin theta],[sin theta,cos theta]].
v=r(rho_dot e_r+theta_dot e_theta).
a=r[(rho_ddot+rho_dot^2-theta_dot^2)e_r+(theta_ddot+2 rho_dot theta_dot)e_theta].
Cartesian gradient equals (f_rho e_r+f_theta e_theta)/r; physical force scaling still requires a model.
Hash address, time tick and seed to a reproducible bit used as a bounded signed perturbation or selector.
Authoritative residual f is enclosed by [f-epsilon_j,f+epsilon_j]; epsilon_j must remain below the event margin.
Keep linear time and map it to phase plus integer winding; the source timestamp is profile metadata with a declared unit.
Record winding count and parity separately from periodic phase so repeated coordinates retain history.
On odd radial wraps apply theta+pi, phi->-phi and orientation flip; base gluing is not itself a Klein quotient.
Use theta->pi-theta plus phi and orientation reversal on odd radial wraps to obtain an orientation-reversing quotient.
The chart transition sends dtheta and dphi to their negatives on odd reflective wraps; it is not a physical impulse.
Crossing rho_max emits a transition with coordinate map, orientation patch, wrap count and lineage.
Store angle, angular velocity and angular acceleration as separate typed coordinates.
Only after declaring inertia, damping and stiffness may torque be computed as I alpha+c omega+k phi.
Model the missing shackle as removal of one constraint-Jacobian row.
Compare nullities before and after row deletion; one independent row can add one degree of freedom.
A declared guard partitions state into branch 0 or 1 and selects a transition/grammar rule.
Binary branching is deterministic; chaos requires a defined dynamical map and measured sensitivity/Lyapunov evidence.
Each F emits two dyadically scaled branches, a typed turn and jitter token under depth, symbol and stack budgets.
A topological orientation flip maps positive turns to negative turns and vice versa.
Quantize rho, theta, modular time and phi into exactly 64 field bits with declared ranges and errors.
Pack fields into source table ranges [63:44],[43:26],[25:12],[11:0].
Interleave rho19,theta17,time13,phi11, then continue round-robin until all 64 bits are consumed.
The contiguous table and interleaved Morton word are two distinct encodings, never silently treated as the same bit layout.
Appending a bit fixes one scheduled coordinate bit and refines a quantized cell; it does not directly divide rho or theta values.
Use a radix trie over key prefixes rather than calling the structure a comparison-based binary search tree.
A leaf bit may encode route, occupancy class or predicate result; continuous residual, uncertainty and lineage remain external.
Pointerless sparse storage still needs topology/presence bits and rank/select or equivalent navigation metadata.

mechanism: Eight raw keys per cache line
formal_definition: A 64-byte line stores eight 64-bit keys; this does not imply eight evaluations in one cycle.
Report 3x,32x and 42.666x only as bit-width ratios because the compared records do not preserve equal semantics.
The 20+18+14+12 profile has exactly 2^64 address combinations, not infinite detail.
Fixed-width array/hash lookup may be constant expected RAM access after key construction; traversal, decoding, verification and storage remain costs.
SCLP outputs feed support, compatibility, guard, verified event, transition and lineage in that order.
